limitations: Cold positions are endpoints, not trajectory proof.
Phase world state carries forward; no savings comparison.
Worst window is maximum observed64-loop mean, not worst frame or p99.
128 raw loops per phase do not cover all measured chunks.
Emulator qualifies controller/scene correctness only; hardware cadence remains separate.
Private quieting, controller and observer footprint remain unpriced; hardware performance needs root qualification.
Moving window changes its view; parked view is the selected midpoint, not a pixel-identical moving-frame A/B.
One-time relocation and speed clearing occur outside measured windows. Normal physics/logic continue.
New pose storage and fixed-camera selector overhead are unpriced.
hourZero is an inherited field name: in this fixture it verifies noon (12), not midnight.
Elapsed buckets include preemption and instrumentation. Render phase includes HUD and renderer-side CPU work, not geometry alone.
Wait intervals include queue servicing and SDK call overhead; they are not pure VU/GS busy time.
Closure proves accounting consistency; source coverage review is separately required.
OFF retains code/data footprint and metadata; runtime contrasts do not price that common footprint.
Moving view differs across frames/boots. No automatic tax subtraction.
Exclusive elapsed queue subpaths include clocks/counters/preemption. Unobserved render is an explicit residual, not queue work.
Same-ELF active observer contrasts do not price common footprint or establish a uniform per-scope subtraction.
Input qwords are not physical DMA traffic. Copied/borrowed bytes describe snapshot output ownership, not unique mesh data.
Calls/bytes refer to the 128-row active cohort only; moving workload and selected park pose can change with observer cadence.
Presentation leaf waits are covered by pacing and never charged twice. Dense stage/work tags are compiled no-ops.
